paite: Huan ni khat tempul a mite thu hilh a, tanchinhoih agen lai in, siampu liante, laigelhmite, upate toh akiang ah ahong pai guih uhi.
heading: Thuneihna Thu Ginlelhna / (Mat 21.23-27; Mar 11.27-33)
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

paite: Akiang ah, "Kua thu in ahia hiai thilte na hih? Kua'n ahia thu hon pia? hon hilh in," achi uhi.
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng thu kam khat ka hon dong sam ding; hon dawng un," achi hi.
english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

paite: "Johan baptisma van a kipan hia, mihing a kipan?" chi in adong hi.
english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

paite: Akingaihtuah ua, "Van a kipan chi lehang, bangziak a amah gingta lou? hon chi thepthup ding hi.
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

paite: Huan mihing a kipan chi lehang lah, mi tengteng in suang in ahon deng ding ua; Johan zawlnei ahih lam athei ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

paite: Huchi in adawng ua, "Koi a kipan ahia ka thei kei uh," achi uhi.
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Ke'n leng kua thu in ahia hiai thil ka hih chih ka hon hilh sam kei ding,” achi hi.
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

paite: Huan mipite kiang ah hiai gentehna agen a, "Mi kuahiam in grephuan abawl a, aloukemte kiang ah khohloh ding in apia a, sawtpi taam ding in gamdang ah ahohta hi.
heading: Grephuan Kemte Gentehna / (Mat 21.33-46; Mar 12.1-12)
english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

paite: Huan agah loh hun in atan ding gah apiak ding un loukemte kiang ah sikha khat asawl hi Himahleh loukemte'n a na vua uhi.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

paite: Sikha dang asawl nawn a; huai leng na vo nawn in, zumhuaipi in ana bawl ua, khutvuak in apaisak nawnta uhi.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

paite: Huan athumna asawl nawn a; huai leng hihliam in apaikhia uhi.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

paite: Huai zoh in grephuan neipa'n, 'Bangchi in ka hihta dia? Ka tapa deihtak ka sawlmai ding; amah ana zah khamoh kei ding uh,' achi hi.
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

paite: Himahleh loukemte'n amah ana muhtak un, 'Hiai gouluah dingpa ahi, that ni, huchi in agou ei a ahi ding,' chi in akihou uhi.
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

paite: Huchi in grephuan a pan apaikhia ua, ahihlumta uhi. Huan grephuan neipa'n amaute bang alohta dia le?
english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

paite: Loukemte ahong hihmang dia, huan grephuan midangte ape ding," achi hi. Huan huai azak un, "Huai tel zaw tung keileh," achi uhi.
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

paite: Himahleh amaute a-en a, ahihleh hiai thu agelh uh bang ahia? "Inn lam mite suang deih louhpen, huai mahmah aning a suang phatuampen ahong hita, chih.
english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

paite: Kuapeuh huai suang tung a puk akitatgawp ding; adelhkhakte houh adelhzan lai ding," achi hi.
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

paite: Huai laitak in laigelhmite leh siampu liante'n mat atum ua; himahleh huai gentehna amau dem a agen ahi chih atheih ziak un, mipi alau uhi.
heading: Siah Piak Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.15-22; Mar 12.13-17)
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

paite: Gam-ukpa vaihawmna leh thuneihna nuai a apiaktheihna ding un, athu genkhelh tang in a-enkhia ua, mihoih a kibawl enkhetu aguk sawl uhi.
english: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

paite: Amau akiang ah, "Sinsakpa, diktak in thu gen in na sinsak zel a, kuamah khentuam nei lou in chihtaktak in Pathian thu na hilh zel chih ka thei uh.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

paite: Kaisar kiang a siah ka piak uh asiang hia, siang lou?" chi in adong uhi.
english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

paite: Himahleh ama'n adoha lungput uh athei a, akiang uah, "Bang achia hon ze-et na hi ua?" achi hi.
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

paite: "Na sumtang uh hon lak un, kua lim leh kua min ahia tuang?" achi a, amau, "Kaisar lim,” achi uhi.
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Huchi ahih nung, Kaisar thilte Kaisar kiang ah pia unla, Pathian thilte Pathian kiang ah pia un," achi hi.
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

paite: Huchi in mipi ma a paukhelh lak ding amu kei ua; adawnna lamdang asa mahmah ua, adai dide uhi.
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

paite: Huan Saddukai, thohnawnna a-om kei chite lak a mi kuate hiam akiang ah ahong ua; thu adong uhi.
heading: Thohnawnna Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.23-33; Mar 12.18-27)
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

paite: "Sinsakpa, Mosi in, mi'n zi nei in, ta nei lou in sihsan taleh a-unaupa'n azi luah in, a-unaupa a ding in chi asuahsak ding chih, agelh hi.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

paite: Ahi a, unau pasal sagih a-om ua; upapen in zi anei a, ta nei lou in asi hi.
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

paite: Anihna in aluah a; ta nei lou in asi nawn hi.
english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

paite: Athumna in aluah nawn a, huchibang in unau sagihte'n anei chiat ua, ta nei lou in asi uhi.
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

paite: Atawpna ah numei leng asita hi.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

paite: Huchi ahihleh thohnawn hun ah akua pen zi ahi dia? Amau sagihte'n zi in anei chiat ngal ua," achi uhi.
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

paite: Huan Jesu'n akiang uah, "Tulai mite zi leh ta in akinei zel ua,
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

paite: himahleh huai hun chiang a tel tak ding leh misi lak a pan thohnawnna tang tak a seh peuhmahte, zi leh ta in akinei nawn kei ding uh.
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

paite: Sih leng asi thei nawn kei ding uh, angelte bang a om ding ahi ngal ua; thohnawnna tate ahih ziak un, Pathian tate ahi ding uh," achi hi.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

paite: "Misi kaihthoh in a-om ding uh chih Mosi in leng loubuk ah, Toupa, Abraham' Pathian, Isak' Pathian, Jakob' Pathian, achih lai in, atheisak hi.
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

paite: Amah misi Pathian ahi kei a, mihing Pathian ahi zaw; amah ngaih in mi tengteng ahing vek ngal ua,” achi hi.
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

paite: Laigelhmite lak a kuate hiam in, "Sinsakpa, na gen dik e,” chi in adawng uhi.
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

paite: Huchi in thudang adong ngam nawn kei uhi.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

paite: Huan ama'n akiang uah Khrist, David tapa ahi chih bangchidan a chi thei uh ahia?
heading: Messia Thu A Dotna / (Mat 22.41-46; Mar 12.35-37)
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

paite: Sam laibu ah David mahmah in, "Toupa'n, ka Toupa kiang ah, ka taklam a tu in,
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

paite: Na khepek ngakna ding a na melmate ka bawl masiah," ana chi hi.
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

paite: Huchi in David in amah, "Toupa achi ngal a, bangchi in ahia atapa ahihtheih?" achi hi.
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

paite: Huan mi tengteng theih in anungzuite kiang ah, laigelhmite lak ah pilvang un.
heading: Laigelhmite Vauhilhna / (Mat 23.1-36; Mar 12.38-40)
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

paite: "Amau puanaktual silh a vak a-ut ua, dawr mun ah chibai buk leh sinagog a tutphah hoihpen a tut, ankuangluina ah mun hoihpen adeihtuam nak uhi.
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

paite: Meithaite innte anegai ua, mi khemna ding in sawt pipi athum uhi. Huaite'n siam louh anak tan sem ding uhi," achi hi.
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”
